arm_1_nf4_base_plus_adapter.description: Base model loaded in 4-bit NF4, adapter applied via PEFT. Emulates training forward pass.
arm_1_nf4_base_plus_adapter.notes: Requires CUDA GPU with bitsandbytes and Common Voice audio files.

arm_2_merge_dequantized_nf4.description: Dequantize 4-bit NF4 weights to FP16/FP32 and merge adapter delta directly into dequantized base.
arm_2_merge_dequantized_nf4.notes: Addresses quantization disparity where adapter was optimized against quantized representations.

arm_3_fp32_remerge.description: Standard merge into unquantized FP32 base checkpoint (as performed in zero-notebook).

recommendation.action: Do NOT retrain yet. Execute Arm 1 and Arm 2 on GPU (Modal / Kaggle). If neither Arm 1 nor Arm 2 reaches <= 12.76% WER, propose updating the claims register to the measured served WER (13.03% FP16 / 14.15% Turbo) rather than retraining.
